title: Device protection add-on never ordered
context: Account 9053-2217. A device protection add-on at 7.99 per month has billed for four months. The order log shows the add-on was attached during an in-store upgrade. The agent can remove the add-on immediately and refund up to three months of an unused add-on.
customer_turns: There is a device protection charge of seven ninety-nine on account 9053-2217 that I never asked for. It has been billing for four months.
The only time I entered a store was the upgrade in May, and nobody mentioned insurance. I have never made a claim on it either.
Please take it off and tell me how much of the four months you are refunding. Say so now rather than leaving it to the next bill.
resolution_space: Remove the add-on and refund three months
Remove the add-on and refund the full four months as goodwill
Remove the add-on going forward with no refund, citing the in-store order record
Escalate to the retail sales audit team

title: Proration after a mid-cycle plan change
context: Account 6614-7728. The customer moved from a 25.00 plan to a 40.00 plan on the 18th of the cycle. The bill shows 25.00, a credit of 9.68, and 40.00, totalling 55.32. The agent can explain proration, can issue goodwill up to 15.00, and cannot alter billing dates.
customer_turns: My bill on 6614-7728 is fifty-five thirty-two and I changed to a forty-pound plan. Three separate lines appear and none matches what I expected.
I accept that I owe something for the part-month, but I was told on the call that the change would take effect next month with no overlap.
Either the fifty-five thirty-two is correct and you explain it so I can check it, or it is not and you adjust it. Which is it?
resolution_space: Explain the proration lines and confirm the total as correct
Apply a goodwill credit for the difference caused by the misquoted effective date
Reverse the plan change and rebill on the original plan
Escalate to the billing review team

title: Late fee after an on-time payment
context: Account 3390-1145. A late fee of 12.00 was applied on the 6th. The payment record shows funds received on the 5th, one day inside the due date, but posted on the 7th. The agent can remove an incorrectly applied fee without approval.
customer_turns: Account 3390-1145 has a twelve-pound late fee on it. I paid on the fifth, before the due date, and I have the bank reference in front of me.
Your system posted it on the seventh, but that is your processing time, not my delay. The money left my account on the fifth and the bank confirms it.
I want the twelve pounds removed and I want to know it will not recur next month. Can you confirm both of those, or only one?
resolution_space: Remove the late fee and confirm the payment date recorded as the 5th
Remove the fee and add a note preventing recurrence while posting lags
Uphold the fee based on the posting date
Escalate to the payments team

title: Replacement SIM not delivered
context: Order SIM-88210, replacement SIM dispatched eleven days ago by untracked post. The service standard is three working days. The agent can resend by tracked courier for next-day delivery and can activate an eSIM immediately on a compatible handset.
customer_turns: I ordered a replacement SIM eleven days ago, order SIM-88210, and it has not arrived. My old one stopped working, so I have had no service.
I have checked with neighbours and the sorting office and nothing is held there. I am also caring for my father, so being without a phone is difficult.
Can you get me working today by any route you have? If not, give me the earliest realistic date so I can borrow a phone.
resolution_space: Activate an eSIM immediately on the customer's handset
Resend the physical SIM by tracked next-day courier
Cancel and reissue the order with a new dispatch reference
Escalate to the logistics team

title: Technician visit rescheduled three times
context: Fault ticket FLT-77123. Three engineer appointments have been booked and cancelled by the network side over four weeks. The agent can book a guaranteed slot with a supervisor hold and can issue 25.00 per missed appointment.
customer_turns: Ticket FLT-77123 has had three engineer appointments and you cancelled every one of them. The fault it was raised for has been live four weeks.
Each time I was told the next slot was guaranteed. I rearranged work for all three and the last cancellation arrived by text forty minutes beforehand.
I am not booking a fourth appointment on the same terms. Tell me what you can guarantee now and what you are paying for the three failures.
resolution_space: Book a supervisor-held slot with a guaranteed attendance commitment
Issue the missed-appointment payment for each of the three failures
Offer a temporary service workaround while the fault stands
Escalate to the field operations manager

title: Broadband drops every evening
context: Line 0208-441-2290. Line diagnostics show repeated resyncs between 19:00 and 23:00 over fourteen days, consistent with an external line fault. The agent can book an engineer, can apply a fault credit, and cannot fix the line remotely.
customer_turns: My broadband on 0208-441-2290 disconnects several times every evening, always between about seven and eleven. During the day it is perfectly stable.
I have already replaced the cables, moved the router and done a factory reset on your instructions. The pattern has not changed at all since then.
I would like an engineer booked and a date. If you want more remote tests first, tell me how long that takes before anyone comes.
resolution_space: Book an engineer visit and confirm the appointment window
Run a further remote line test with a stated turnaround, then book
Apply a service credit for the affected period
Escalate to the network fault team

title: Voicemail not delivering messages
context: Mobile number 0790-882-1176. Voicemail deposits are recorded on the platform but delivery notifications are not sent; the mailbox greeting plays normally. The agent can reset the mailbox, which erases stored messages, and can retrieve existing messages before the reset.
customer_turns: People tell me they leave voicemails on 0790-882-1176 and I never get a notification. When I dial the mailbox it says I have no new messages.
I run a small business from this number, so I have probably lost enquiries this fortnight. Two customers have told me directly that they left messages.
Can you recover anything sitting on the system and then fix the notifications? Tell me if fixing it means losing whatever is stored there.
resolution_space: Retrieve stored messages, then reset the mailbox
Reset the mailbox immediately, accepting message loss
Reconfigure notification delivery without a reset
Escalate to the voicemail platform team

title: Terminating early because of no coverage at a new address
context: Account 9921-3340, mobile contract with nine months remaining. Coverage at the new address is recorded as poor indoors. Policy allows termination without charge if a coverage complaint has been open for thirty days without resolution; the complaint is fourteen days old.
customer_turns: I moved house six weeks ago and my mobile on account 9921-3340 has no usable signal indoors. I have to stand in the garden to hold a call.
I raised this fourteen days ago and was sent a signal booster that made no difference. Nine months remain on the contract and I cannot use it.
I want to leave without paying those nine months. Tell me whether that is possible now, or what has to happen first before it is.
resolution_space: Terminate without charge once the coverage complaint reaches thirty days
Terminate now with the early termination charge applied
Keep the complaint open and offer a monthly credit until day thirty
Escalate to the coverage complaints team

title: Changing the name on the account after marriage
context: Account 2287-9041. The customer has changed their surname and asks for the account, bills and direct debit to be updated. Policy requires sight of a marriage certificate or deed poll. The agent can accept a scanned document and can update the name within one billing cycle.
customer_turns: I changed my surname after getting married and account 2287-9041 still shows the old one. My bank details are already updated under the new name.
The mismatch is causing problems, because the direct debit reference no longer matches my bank records and my last payment was queried by them.
What document do you need and how do I send it? I would like the bills to show the new name from the next cycle.
resolution_space: Accept a scanned certificate and update the name within one cycle
Require the original document by post before updating
Update the name and separately correct the direct debit mandate
Escalate to the account administration team

title: Plan downgrade blocked in the app
context: Account 4471-9982 on a 45.00 plan. The app blocks downgrades because a device instalment plan is attached, requiring a minimum airtime tier of 30.00. The requested 20.00 plan is below that floor. The agent can move the customer to a 30.00 plan today.
customer_turns: Your app will not let me move to the twenty-pound plan on account 4471-9982. It shows the plan, lets me select it, then fails with an error.
I bought my phone through you on instalments, which I pay separately each month. That is the only thing I can think of that makes my account different.
Is the twenty-pound plan available to me or not? If not, tell me the lowest one I can have and put me on it.
resolution_space: Move the customer to the lowest permitted plan at 30.00
Explain the instalment floor and keep the current plan
Settle the instalment balance to unlock lower tiers
Escalate to the plan management team

title: Adding an authorised user to manage the account
context: Account 8804-1267. The named holder wants a relative to be able to discuss and change the account. Policy permits a nominated user with the holder's verbal authorisation on the line, limited to service changes and excluding contract cancellation.
customer_turns: I want my daughter to be able to deal with account 8804-1267 for me. I am in hospital a while and cannot always take calls or reach a computer.
She lives at a different address and is not on the bill, so I expect you need something from me. I am the account holder and I am here.
Can we set that up in this conversation, and what will she be allowed to do afterwards? I need to know before I hand anything over.
resolution_space: Add a nominated user with the stated permissions during this call
Require written authorisation before adding the user
Add the user with a narrower permission set
Escalate to the account administration team

title: Charged at full price after a voucher was applied
context: Order R-482013. A 20 percent voucher was accepted at checkout but the captured amount is the full 96.00. The order record shows the voucher recorded and not deducted. The agent can refund the 19.20 difference to the original card and cannot reissue an expired voucher.
customer_turns: Order R-482013 was charged at ninety-six pounds even though the twenty percent voucher went through at checkout. The confirmation screen showed the reduced total before I paid.
I still have the confirmation email listing the voucher code, but the amount at the bottom is the full price. Your own email contradicts itself.
I want the nineteen twenty difference back on my card. Can you do that today, and how long before it shows on my statement?
resolution_space: Refund the price difference to the original card
Issue store credit for the difference
Decline and explain a voucher exclusion on the items ordered
Escalate to the payments team

title: Delivery charge on an order above the free threshold
context: Order R-490771, basket value 58.00 against a free delivery threshold of 50.00. A 4.95 delivery charge was applied because one item ships from a partner warehouse. The exclusion is stated on the product page. The agent can refund the charge as goodwill once per customer.
customer_turns: I was charged four ninety-five delivery on order R-490771 even though the basket came to fifty-eight pounds. Your banner says delivery is free over fifty.
I have ordered from you several times and never paid delivery on a basket this size. Nothing at checkout warned me that this order would be treated differently.
Refund the four ninety-five or tell me clearly why it stands. If there is an exception I should have seen, show me where it was.
resolution_space: Refund the delivery charge as a one-off goodwill gesture
Explain the partner-warehouse exclusion and uphold the charge
Issue a free-delivery code for a future order
Escalate to the customer care team

title: Pending authorisation held after a cancelled order
context: Order R-501228 was cancelled by the warehouse before dispatch. The 214.00 authorisation is still held on the customer's card. Authorisations release in five to ten days depending on the issuing bank; the agent cannot release them directly.
customer_turns: You cancelled order R-501228 yourselves because the item was out of stock, but two hundred and fourteen pounds is still showing as pending on my card six days later.
Your email said no payment had been taken. My bank shows the money as unavailable to me, so whatever it is called, I cannot spend it.
Tell me exactly when that hold disappears and what you can do to speed it up. I need the money before the weekend.
resolution_space: Issue a written release confirmation the customer can give their bank
Explain the authorisation window and the bank's role
Request an expedited void through the payment provider
Escalate to the payments team

title: Parcel marked delivered but not received
context: Order R-530918. The courier records delivery to a safe place on the 9th with a photograph of a doorway that is not the customer's. The agent can issue a replacement immediately or refund, and must record a non-delivery claim with the courier.
customer_turns: Order R-530918 says delivered on the ninth but nothing arrived. The photograph on the tracking page shows a blue front door and mine is white with a glass panel.
I have asked both neighbours and checked with the building's post room. Nobody has it, and no card was left anywhere on the property.
Please either send it again or refund me. I need it by Friday, so if a replacement cannot arrive by then, refund instead.
resolution_space: Dispatch a replacement with a stated delivery date
Refund the order in full
Open a courier non-delivery claim before deciding
Escalate to the delivery investigations team

title: Order stuck at preparing for dispatch
context: Order R-541220, placed nine days ago, status preparing for dispatch. Stock shows zero for one of the three items. The agent can split the order and ship the available items today, can cancel the unavailable item, and cannot give a restock date.
customer_turns: My order R-541220 has said preparing for dispatch for nine days. Nothing has moved on the tracking page and I have had no emails since the confirmation.
There are three items in it and two of them are for a birthday on Saturday. The third is not urgent and I would happily wait for that one separately.
Can you send what you have now and deal with the rest later? If not, tell me and I will cancel the whole thing.
resolution_space: Split the order and ship available items today
Cancel the unavailable item and refund it
Hold the order until complete with a revised estimate
Escalate to the fulfilment team

title: Furniture delivery window missed twice
context: Order R-560442, a sofa with a two-man delivery. Two booked windows passed with no delivery and no contact. The next available slot is eighteen days out. The agent can offer a 50.00 goodwill credit and can request a priority slot with no guarantee.
customer_turns: My sofa on order R-560442 has had two delivery windows and neither happened. Both times I waited the whole day and nobody arrived or called to explain.
I have no seating in the living room because I disposed of the old sofa before the first date. That is now nearly three weeks of an empty room.
I need a date that will actually hold, and I want to know what you are doing about the two that did not.
resolution_space: Book a priority slot and confirm the earliest realistic date
Apply a goodwill credit for the failed deliveries
Cancel the order and refund in full
Escalate to the large-item delivery team

title: Checkout fails at the payment step
context: Customer account A-88102. Checkout fails with a generic error at the payment step on card and wallet. Logs show the failures come from an address-verification mismatch with the saved billing address. The agent can clear the saved address and can place the order manually.
customer_turns: Your checkout fails every time I try to pay on account A-88102. It thinks for a moment and then shows an error that just says something went wrong.
I have tried two different cards and a digital wallet, on both my laptop and my phone. My bank confirms no attempt has even reached them, so it is failing before that.
Can you place the order for me, or fix whatever is wrong on the account? The sale ends tonight, so timing matters here.
resolution_space: Clear the saved billing address and have the customer retry
Place the order manually on the customer's behalf
Extend the sale price for this customer beyond the deadline
Escalate to the web platform team

title: Loyalty points not credited for recent orders
context: Account A-90337. Three orders in the last two months show no loyalty points. The account was migrated to a new loyalty scheme in August and points accrual was not re-linked. The agent can credit missing points manually after checking order values.
customer_turns: My loyalty points have not moved on account A-90337 despite three orders in the last two months. The balance is exactly what it was at the end of July.
I did get an email in August about the scheme changing, and I clicked through and accepted the new terms at the time. Everything else on my account looks normal.
Please add the points I should have earned and confirm the new balance. I want to use them on an order this week.
resolution_space: Credit the missing points manually and confirm the balance
Re-link the account to the loyalty scheme and backdate accrual
Offer an equivalent voucher instead of points
Escalate to the loyalty team

title: Wrong size shipped against the size guide
context: Order R-591804 for a jacket in size medium. The delivered garment is labelled medium but measures to the size guide's small. A supplier sizing error is recorded for this batch. The agent can exchange for a large at the medium price and can refund with free return.
customer_turns: The jacket on order R-591804 is labelled medium but it fits like a small. I measured it against your own size guide and the chest is four centimetres under.
I usually take a medium in your clothing and have three other items from you that fit properly. So this is not me having ordered the wrong size.
I want one that actually fits. Is a large going to be right given the mislabelling, and will I pay the difference?
resolution_space: Exchange for a large at the original price with free return
Refund in full with free return postage
Send a replacement medium from a different batch
Escalate to the buying and quality team

title: Digital gift card code not working
context: Gift card GC-44821 for 50.00, purchased eleven days ago. The code is valid but was partially redeemed for 12.00 against an order the recipient does not recognise. The agent can void the balance and reissue a new code for the remaining 38.00 and can investigate the redemption.
customer_turns: The gift card code GC-44821 my sister sent me will not work at checkout. It was for fifty pounds and your site says the balance is not enough for my order.
My order is only forty-five pounds, so fifty should easily cover it. I have never used this code before and it arrived by email eleven days ago.
Can you tell me what happened to the missing money and give me a working code for what is left? I would like both today.
resolution_space: Void the card and reissue the remaining balance as a new code
Investigate the earlier redemption before reissuing
Reissue the full original value as a goodwill decision
Escalate to the gift card fraud team

title: Cancelling an order that has already been picked
context: Order R-600471, placed two hours ago, already picked and awaiting courier collection. Cancellation is not possible once picked. The agent can flag for a refuse-on-delivery return or issue a prepaid return label, both refunding in full on receipt.
customer_turns: I placed order R-600471 two hours ago and I need to cancel it. I ordered the wrong model and the right one is a different product entirely.
Your cancel button has already disappeared from the order page, and the status says it is being prepared. Nothing has actually left your building yet as far as I can tell.
So can it be stopped, and if not, what do I do when it arrives? I want the refund without paying postage.
resolution_space: Flag the parcel for refuse on delivery with a full refund
Issue a prepaid return label for return after delivery
Attempt a courier recall before dispatch
Escalate to the fulfilment team

title: Returning a sale item outside the standard window
context: Order R-611228, sale item delivered thirty-six days ago. The standard return window is thirty days, extended to sixty for account holders, which this customer is. The item is unused with tags attached. The agent can accept the return under the extended window.
customer_turns: I would like to return a dress from order R-611228. It was delivered thirty-six days ago and it has never been worn, with the tags still attached.
I know your headline policy says thirty days, and I have gone past that. It was bought for an event that was cancelled, which is why it sat unopened.
Is there any route for me to return it? If there is, tell me what I get back and whether it is money or credit.
resolution_space: Accept the return under the extended account-holder window for a full refund
Accept the return as store credit only
Decline as outside the applicable window
Escalate to the returns team

title: Partial refund after a damaged-item return
context: Return RET-24001 for a mirror that arrived cracked. The refund issued was 61.00 against a paid price of 79.00, with an unexplained deduction. Damaged-on-arrival returns are refunded in full including delivery. The agent can release the 18.00 difference.
customer_turns: I returned a cracked mirror under RET-24001 and received sixty-one pounds back. I paid seventy-nine, including delivery, and the crack was there when I opened the box.
There is no explanation anywhere for the eighteen pounds that is missing. Your email just states the refunded amount without breaking it down at all.
I want the rest of my money. Confirm the eighteen pounds is coming and when, or tell me what it was deducted for.
resolution_space: Release the outstanding 18.00 to the original payment method
Provide a breakdown and uphold the deduction
Refund the difference as store credit
Escalate to the returns team

title: Cancelling a recurring subscription box
context: Subscription S-78902, monthly at 39.00, inside a six-month commitment with two months elapsed. Early cancellation carries a 30.00 charge. The agent can pause for up to three months free of charge or cancel with the charge applied.
customer_turns: I want to cancel the monthly box on subscription S-78902. My circumstances have changed and thirty-nine pounds a month is not something I can keep doing.
I signed up in a promotion and I now see there was a six-month commitment attached. I am two months into it, so four are apparently left.
What does stopping it cost me, and is there anything cheaper than cancelling outright? Give me the numbers and I will decide.
resolution_space: Cancel now and apply the early cancellation charge
Pause the subscription for up to three months at no charge
Downgrade to a cheaper tier for the remaining term
Escalate to the subscriptions team

title: Refund for a gift bought by someone else
context: Order R-630558 placed by a third party and shipped to the customer as a gift. The customer has no account and no order confirmation, only a gift receipt. Policy refunds gifts as store credit to the recipient; money refunds go to the purchaser only.
customer_turns: I was given a coffee grinder from order R-630558 as a birthday present. I already own the same model, so I would like to return it unopened.
I do not have an account with you and I did not pay for it. All I have is the gift receipt with the order number.
Would I get money or a credit, and can this be done without involving the person who bought it? I would rather not mention it to them.
resolution_space: Accept the return and issue store credit to the recipient
Refund the purchaser's original payment method only
Offer an exchange for another item of equal value
Escalate to the returns team

title: Cannot update the delivery address on the account
context: Account A-92788. Address updates fail validation because the new address is a new-build not yet in the postal database. The agent can enter a manual address override and can ship to the address once overridden.
customer_turns: I cannot change the delivery address on account A-92788. Your form rejects my new address and says it cannot be found whichever way I type it.
It is a new-build flat that was finished in June. Two other retailers have delivered here fine, but their forms let me type the address without a lookup.
Can you put it on the account manually? I have an order I want to place tonight and it must go to the new address.
resolution_space: Enter a manual address override on the account
Place the order with a one-off manual delivery address
Ship to a nearby collection point instead
Escalate to the digital support team

title: Marketing preferences ignored after opting out
context: Account A-93012. The customer opted out of marketing email six weeks ago; the preference is recorded, but a legacy list in a separate system is still sending. The agent can suppress the address across all systems within 72 hours.
customer_turns: I turned off marketing emails on account A-93012 six weeks ago and I still get several a week from you. The setting in my account shows everything switched off.
I have also used the unsubscribe link at the bottom of two of them. Neither made any difference and one of them returned an error page when I clicked it.
Please stop them properly and tell me when they will actually end. If they continue past that date I want to know who to contact.
resolution_space: Apply a full suppression across all systems with a stated effective date
Confirm the account preference and re-run the unsubscribe
Close the account entirely at the customer's request
Escalate to the data protection team

title: Requesting deletion of a shopping account
context: Account A-93440. The customer asks for account deletion. Two orders are within the returns window and one has an open warranty claim. Policy retains transaction records for six years for tax purposes while deleting profile and marketing data.
customer_turns: I would like my account A-93440 deleted along with everything you hold about me. I do not intend to shop with you again after the last experience.
I do still have an open warranty claim on a blender and one order that has not arrived yet, so I cannot simply walk away this week.
Tell me what can be deleted now, what has to wait, and what you keep regardless. Then I will decide when to go ahead.
resolution_space: Delete profile and marketing data now while retaining transaction records
Schedule deletion for after the open claim and return windows close
Suspend the account instead of deleting it
Escalate to the data protection team

title: Overdraft interest after a promised buffer
context: Account ending 2290. Overdraft interest of 18.60 was charged for six days. The notes record an agreed fee-free buffer of 100.00 arranged on a call in July, which was never applied to the account. The agent can refund charges arising from an unapplied arrangement.
customer_turns: I have been charged eighteen sixty in overdraft interest on the account ending 2290. I was told in July that I would have a hundred pound buffer with no charges.
I went about sixty pounds overdrawn for less than a week, which should have been inside that buffer. Nothing on my statements suggests the buffer was ever there.
Can you check the July call and put this right? I want the eighteen sixty back and the buffer actually applied going forward.
resolution_space: Refund the interest and apply the agreed buffer
Apply the buffer going forward without refunding past interest
Uphold the charges if no arrangement is evidenced
Escalate to the complaints team

title: Direct debit collected after cancellation
context: Account ending 5512. A direct debit for 62.00 was collected four days after the customer cancelled the mandate in the app. The cancellation is recorded. Under the direct debit guarantee the agent can issue an immediate indemnity refund.
customer_turns: A direct debit of sixty-two pounds came out of the account ending 5512 four days after I cancelled it in your app. The app still shows it as cancelled.
I cancelled because I had already closed the account with that company. They have no right to be taking anything and I told them so in writing last month.
I want the sixty-two pounds back from you today under the guarantee, not in a week once you have asked them about it.
resolution_space: Issue an immediate indemnity refund under the direct debit guarantee
Investigate with the originator before refunding
Refund and place a block on future collections from that originator
Escalate to the payments team

title: Duplicate card payment at a retailer
context: Card ending 8890. Two identical payments of 74.50 to the same retailer are posted ninety seconds apart; one is still pending. The agent can advise on the pending item, can raise a duplicate-transaction dispute once posted, and cannot cancel a pending authorisation.
customer_turns: My card ending 8890 shows two payments of seventy-four fifty to the same shop, ninety seconds apart. I only made one purchase and I have one receipt.
The assistant did say the terminal had failed the first time and asked me to tap again. Clearly it did not fail, because both attempts are on my statement.
Which one do I get back, and do I have to go back to the shop first? Tell me the fastest route to my money.
resolution_space: Raise a duplicate-transaction dispute once the pending item posts
Advise contacting the retailer for a direct refund first
Monitor the pending item and refund if it settles
Escalate to the disputes team

title: Monthly account fee on an account sold as free
context: Account ending 3308. A 9.95 monthly account fee has been charged for seven months. The account was opened on a free tier and auto-migrated to a packaged tier during a product change, with notice sent by post. The agent can refund up to three months and can switch back to a free tier.
customer_turns: I have been charged nine ninety-five a month on the account ending 3308 for seven months. I opened this account because it was advertised as free banking.
I never agreed to any package. I do not use the travel insurance or the breakdown cover that apparently come with it, and I have never made a claim on either.
Put me back on a free account and tell me how much of the seventy pounds you are returning. I want the figure now.
resolution_space: Switch to a free tier and refund three months of fees
Switch to a free tier and refund all seven months as goodwill
Switch tier with no refund, citing the posted notice
Escalate to the complaints team

title: Account opening stuck in verification
context: Application AP-77201, submitted seventeen days ago, status in verification. The identity document uploaded is expired. No notification was sent to the applicant. The agent can request a new document and can complete verification within one working day of receipt.
customer_turns: I applied for an account seventeen days ago, application AP-77201, and it still says in verification. Nothing has been asked of me since I submitted everything.
I need the account open to receive my salary on the twenty-eighth. My employer needs the details at least a week before that to set it up.
Tell me what is holding it up and what you need from me. If it cannot be done by the twenty-first, I need to know now.
resolution_space: Request a valid identity document and commit to a one-day turnaround
Offer branch verification as a faster route
Withdraw and resubmit the application
Escalate to the onboarding team

title: Standing order missed on the due date
context: Standing order SO-22104 for 380.00 monthly rent, due on the 1st, not executed because the 1st fell on a bank holiday and the instruction is set to non-working-day skip. The agent can send the payment today and can change the rule to next working day.
customer_turns: My standing order SO-22104 for three hundred and eighty pounds did not go out on the first. It is my rent and the landlord has now charged me a late fee.
The money was in the account the whole time, so it was not a shortage. This has never happened in the two years the standing order has been running.
Send it now if you can, and change whatever setting caused this. I also want something in writing explaining it for my landlord.
resolution_space: Send the payment today and change the non-working-day rule
Provide a written explanation for the landlord
Refund the late fee as goodwill
Escalate to the payments team

title: Mortgage offer decision overdue
context: Mortgage application MG-45023, submitted twenty-four days ago; the published service level for an offer decision is fifteen working days. The case is awaiting a valuation booking. The agent can chase the valuer and cannot commit to a decision date.
customer_turns: My mortgage application MG-45023 was submitted twenty-four days ago and there is still no decision. Your website says fifteen working days for an offer.
The seller has given us until the end of next week before they remarket the property. We have already paid for the survey on our side.
What is the actual hold-up and what date can you give me? If no date is possible, tell me that plainly so we can talk to the seller.
resolution_space: Chase the valuation booking and confirm the next milestone date
Request case prioritisation given the seller deadline
Provide written confirmation of application progress for the seller
Escalate to the mortgage underwriting team

title: Mobile app will not open after an update
context: Customer profile ending 6621. The app closes at launch on the customer's device; the fault matches a known incompatibility with an older operating system version. The agent can offer browser banking, telephone banking, and cannot fix the device.
customer_turns: Your app closes immediately every time I open it on my phone, since the update last week. It shows the logo for a second and then disappears.
I have reinstalled it twice and restarted the phone. My phone is a few years old and cannot take any more operating system updates, if that matters.
Give me a way to bank today that works with what I have. I need to move money before this evening is out.
resolution_space: Set up browser banking access on the same device
Register the customer for telephone banking
Arrange a branch appointment for the transaction
Escalate to the digital channels team

title: Cancelling a packaged account within the cooling-off period
context: Packaged account ending 2201, opened nine days ago at 12.00 per month. The cooling-off period is fourteen days with a full fee refund. No insurance claims have been made. The agent can downgrade or close and refund the fee.
customer_turns: I opened a packaged account ending 2201 nine days ago at twelve pounds a month and I want to cancel it. The benefits duplicate cover I already have elsewhere.
I have not claimed on any of the insurance and I have not used the account for anything beyond a single test payment of one pound to myself.
Can I get the fee back and move to a plain account? Tell me whether the account number stays the same, and whether my card changes.
resolution_space: Downgrade to a free account and refund the fee
Close the account entirely and refund the fee
Retain the account with the fee waived for three months
Escalate to the product team

title: Cancelling a loan application before drawdown
context: Loan application LN-55712 approved for 8,000.00, funds not yet released, agreement signed two days ago. The withdrawal right is fourteen days. No fee applies before drawdown. The agent can cancel and confirm nothing is owed.
customer_turns: I signed a loan agreement two days ago under LN-55712 for eight thousand pounds and I want to cancel it. The money has not been paid out yet.
The purchase I needed it for has fallen through, so I no longer need the loan at all. I would rather not have it sitting on my credit file.
Confirm it is cancelled, that I owe nothing, and what happens to the record of it. I want all three in writing.
resolution_space: Cancel the agreement and confirm no sums are owed
Cancel and provide written confirmation for credit reference purposes
Reduce the loan amount instead of cancelling
Escalate to the lending team

title: Refund for a failed international payment
context: International payment IP-88023 of 2,500.00 returned by the beneficiary bank after seven days. 2,455.00 was credited back; 45.00 in intermediary fees was deducted. The agent can refund the fees as goodwill where the return was not the customer's fault.
customer_turns: My international payment IP-88023 for two and a half thousand pounds was returned and only two thousand four hundred and fifty-five came back to me.
The return was because the beneficiary bank rejected it, not because I got anything wrong. The details I gave were exactly what my supplier sent.
I want the forty-five pounds of fees back too. Can you do that, and can you tell me what to change before I resend it?
resolution_space: Refund the intermediary fees as goodwill
Explain the fee deduction and uphold it
Resend the payment free of charge with corrected routing
Escalate to the international payments team

title: Reversing a payment sent to the wrong account
context: Payment PY-66190 of 640.00 sent to an incorrect account number two hours ago. The receiving bank must consent to a return. The agent can raise a misdirected payment claim with a twenty-working-day framework and cannot guarantee recovery.
customer_turns: I sent six hundred and forty pounds two hours ago under PY-66190 and I typed one digit of the account number wrong. It has gone to a stranger.
The name check did warn me that the name did not match, and I clicked through it because I was in a hurry. I realise that was my mistake.
Is there any chance of getting it back, and what do you need from me right now? Please be straight with me about the odds.
resolution_space: Raise a misdirected payment claim under the recovery framework
Contact the receiving bank for consent to return the funds
Explain that recovery depends on the recipient and set expectations
Escalate to the payments investigations team

title: Managing an account for a relative
context: Account ending 4433 held by the customer's father, who is in long-term care. The customer holds a registered power of attorney document not yet recorded on the account. Registration requires document verification, usually taking five working days.
customer_turns: I need to manage my father's account ending 4433. He is in long-term care and can no longer deal with his own bills or correspondence.
I have a registered power of attorney document, but when I rang before I was told it is not showing on the account and I had to send it in.
Tell me exactly what to send, where to send it, and how long it takes. His care home invoice is due in two weeks.
resolution_space: Accept the power of attorney for verification with a stated timescale
Arrange branch verification of the original document
Set up an interim arrangement for the urgent invoice
Escalate to the vulnerable customer support team

title: Business account signatory change
context: Business account ending 7009 for a two-director company. One director has resigned and remains a signatory. A mandate change requires a resolution signed by the remaining directors plus identity verification for any new signatory.
customer_turns: I need to change the signatories on the business account ending 7009. One of our two directors resigned at the end of August and is still on the mandate.
Our new finance director started this week and needs to be able to approve payments. She has never held an account with you before.
What paperwork do you need and how long will this take? Payroll runs on the twenty-fifth and someone must be able to authorise it.
resolution_space: Accept a signed board resolution and verify the new signatory
Arrange an interim single-signatory authority for payroll
Require an in-branch appointment for all parties
Escalate to the business banking team

title: Seat selection charged twice on one booking
context: Booking QK7742, two passengers, seat selection 24.00 per passenger. The card statement shows four charges of 24.00. The booking record lists two seat products. The agent can refund the two unmatched charges and cannot alter the fare.
customer_turns: On booking QK7742 I paid twice for seat selection. There are four charges of twenty-four pounds on my card but only two of us are travelling.
The page timed out when I first selected the seats and I went through it again. Your confirmation email lists two seats, not four, so the extra pair bought nothing.
Refund the two charges that have no seat against them. Confirm the amount and when it lands before we finish, because I am travelling on Friday.
resolution_space: Refund the two unmatched seat charges
Raise a payment investigation before refunding
Issue travel credit of equivalent value
Escalate to the payments team

title: Currency conversion applied against the customer's choice
context: Booking MN3390 priced in euros. The customer chose to pay in euros; the payment settled in pounds through the merchant conversion option at a rate 4 percent above interbank, costing about 31.00 extra. The agent can refund the conversion difference as goodwill.
customer_turns: On booking MN3390 I chose to pay in euros and my card was billed in pounds at a poor rate. It has cost me roughly thirty pounds more than it should.
I remember the currency choice screen and I selected euros deliberately, because my card handles conversion better than any merchant rate does.
Refund the difference caused by converting against my choice. If you cannot do that, say so and tell me who can, so I can take it further.
resolution_space: Refund the conversion difference as goodwill
Provide the payment record showing the currency selected
Decline and refer the customer to the card issuer
Escalate to the payments team

title: Change fee charged on a flexible fare
context: Booking TP1165 on a flexible fare with free date changes and a fare difference payable. A 45.00 change fee plus a 12.00 fare difference were taken. The fare rules confirm no change fee applies. The agent can refund the 45.00.
customer_turns: I moved my flight on booking TP1165 and was charged a forty-five pound change fee plus twelve pounds of fare difference. I bought the flexible fare.
I accept the twelve pounds for the price difference, that is fair. It is the change fee I am disputing, because flexible is supposed to mean no fee.
Refund the forty-five and leave the twelve alone. Confirm that is exactly what you are doing before we end this call, and send it in writing.
resolution_space: Refund the change fee and retain the fare difference
Refund both amounts as goodwill
Review the fare rules before deciding
Escalate to the fares team

title: Car hire deposit not released
context: Car hire booking CH-40027, completed eighteen days ago. A 250.00 security deposit hold remains on the card. The supplier releases holds within ten working days. No damage was recorded at return. The agent can instruct release and cannot move the funds directly.
customer_turns: My car hire booking CH-40027 finished eighteen days ago and the two hundred and fifty pound deposit is still held on my card.
The car was returned with a clean inspection sheet, which I have a copy of, and nobody has contacted me about damage or fuel since.
Get the hold released. Tell me exactly what you can do and by when, because this is money I need available for the rest of the trip.
resolution_space: Instruct the supplier to release the hold with a stated deadline
Provide the inspection record and confirm no charges are pending
Advise the customer to request release through the card issuer
Escalate to the car hire supplier team

title: Refund for a cancelled flight not received
context: Booking LD8801, flight cancelled by the airline thirty-one days ago, refund of 412.00 approved at the time. Published refund turnaround is fourteen days. The refund is queued but unprocessed. The agent can escalate for manual processing.
customer_turns: My flight on booking LD8801 was cancelled by you thirty-one days ago and the four hundred and twelve pound refund has still not arrived.
I was told fourteen days on the call when it was cancelled. I have checked the card the refund was taken from and there is nothing on it.
Process it manually if that is what it takes, and give me a date. I would rather have a real date than another estimate.
resolution_space: Push the refund for manual processing with a committed date
Confirm the refund destination and reissue if misdirected
Offer travel credit as an immediate alternative
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Airport transfer did not arrive
context: Transfer booking TR-29014 for a 06:10 pickup; the driver did not arrive and the customer paid 78.00 for a taxi. The supplier log shows no driver assigned. The agent can refund the transfer and reimburse the taxi up to the transfer value plus 50 percent.
customer_turns: My airport transfer TR-29014 was booked for ten past six and no driver came. I waited twenty-five minutes and then took a taxi for seventy-eight pounds.
I called the number on the voucher twice and it rang out both times. I could not risk missing the flight, so I stopped waiting.
Refund the transfer and cover the taxi fare. Tell me what you will actually pay before I send you the receipt and the booking reference.
resolution_space: Refund the transfer and reimburse the taxi within the policy cap
Refund the transfer only
Request the supplier's driver log before deciding
Escalate to the ground transport team

title: Visa support letter not issued before travel
context: Booking VS-60912. A visa support letter was requested eleven days ago; the standard issue time is five working days. The request failed validation because the passport name field contained an unsupported character. The agent can reissue within one working day.
customer_turns: I asked for a visa support letter for booking VS-60912 eleven days ago and nothing has come. Your site says five working days.
My appointment at the consulate is on Monday and they will not see me without it. My passport name has an accented character, if that is relevant.
Get the letter to me before Monday. Tell me now whether that is possible so I can move the appointment if not.
resolution_space: Reissue the letter within one working day with the corrected field
Provide an interim booking confirmation letter today
Advise rebooking the consulate appointment
Escalate to the documentation team

title: Booking not visible in the account
context: Booking YH7703 was made as a guest with an email address differing by one character from the account email. The booking exists and is valid. The agent can attach the booking to the account after verification.
customer_turns: I made booking YH7703 last month and it does not appear anywhere in my account. I can see older trips but not this one.
I might have checked out as a guest rather than signing in. The confirmation did arrive, but at an address very close to the one on my account.
Attach it to my account so I can manage it myself. Confirm that it is genuinely booked while you are looking at it.
resolution_space: Verify identity and attach the booking to the account
Resend the confirmation to the account email
Advise managing the booking through the guest link
Escalate to the account services team

title: Loyalty number not credited for a flown flight
context: Booking KP2214, flown eighteen days ago. The loyalty number was added after ticketing and did not pass to the flight coupon. Retroactive credit is available within six months with a boarding pass or ticket number. The agent can submit the claim.
customer_turns: I flew on booking KP2214 eighteen days ago and no miles have appeared in my loyalty account. My number was on the booking when I checked in.
I added the number after I had already paid, which may be why it did not follow through. I still have my boarding pass in the app.
Claim the miles for me now. Tell me how long they take to show and whether I need to send anything in, such as the boarding pass.
resolution_space: Submit a retroactive credit claim with the ticket number
Ask the customer to submit the claim through the loyalty portal
Add the loyalty number to the profile for future bookings
Escalate to the loyalty programme team

title: Booking modification page returns an error
context: Booking GS1187 contains a special assistance request, which locks self-service modification. The customer wants to add a bag. The agent can add the bag directly at the online price.
customer_turns: Every time I try to add a bag to booking GS1187 your website gives an error and sends me back to the start of the page.
I have tried on a laptop and a phone, and on two browsers. The booking has a wheelchair assistance request on it, if that changes anything.
Add a twenty-three kilo bag for me at the online price. I do not want to pay the airport rate because your page will not work.
resolution_space: Add the bag directly at the online price
Provide a payment link for the online-priced bag
Remove the modification lock and let the customer retry
Escalate to the bookings systems team

title: Cancelling within twenty-four hours of booking
context: Booking BV3345, made nineteen hours ago, fare 286.00, departure in six weeks. The 24-hour cancellation policy allows a full refund. The agent can cancel and refund in full.
customer_turns: I booked flight BV3345 nineteen hours ago for two hundred and eighty-six pounds and I need to cancel. The trip is not going ahead.
I understand fares are usually non-refundable, but I believe there is a twenty-four hour window and I am inside it by a few hours.
Cancel it and refund the full amount. Confirm the figure and the timescale before we finish, so I have it on record today.
resolution_space: Cancel with a full refund under the 24-hour policy
Cancel with a refund less taxes only
Hold the booking value as a credit
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Cancelling a non-refundable hotel for a medical reason
context: Reservation HR-90023, non-refundable, 410.00 paid, check-in in nine days. A documented medical reason applies. The agent can request a property waiver and can issue credit but cannot refund unilaterally.
customer_turns: I need to cancel reservation HR-90023 for four hundred and ten pounds. I have had surgery scheduled for the same week as the trip.
I know I booked the non-refundable rate. I have a letter from the hospital confirming the date if that helps the case at all.
Ask the hotel to waive it. If they refuse, tell me what else you can offer rather than just closing the case.
resolution_space: Request a property waiver with the medical documentation
Issue travel credit toward a future stay
Change the dates instead of cancelling
Escalate to the hotel partnerships team

title: Refund of taxes on an unused ticket
context: Booking CE4471, non-refundable fare of 190.00, flight not taken. Government taxes and airport charges of 44.60 are refundable on unused tickets, less a 20.00 administration fee. The agent can process the tax refund.
customer_turns: I missed my flight on booking CE4471 and did not travel. The fare was one hundred and ninety pounds and non-refundable, which I accept.
Someone told me the taxes on an unused ticket can still be returned, because the airport charges were never actually incurred by anyone.
Refund whatever part of it I am entitled to. Tell me the exact figure after any fee you take off it, before I agree.
resolution_space: Process the tax refund less the administration fee
Refund taxes in full as goodwill
Decline on the basis of the fare rules
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Refund to a card that has since expired
context: Booking PL2260, refund of 355.00 approved. The original card has expired and been replaced with a new number at the same bank. Refunds route to the issuer, which forwards to the successor card. The agent can explain and can pay by bank transfer if the issuer rejects it.
customer_turns: My refund of three hundred and fifty-five pounds on booking PL2260 is going back to a card that expired in June. That card no longer exists.
The bank is the same and my account is the same, but the card number changed when they reissued it. I do not want this money to vanish.
Send it somewhere it will actually arrive. If it has to go to the old card, explain what happens to it then.
resolution_space: Refund to the original card and explain issuer forwarding
Pay by bank transfer after verification
Hold the refund pending the issuer's response
Escalate to the refunds team

title: Cancelling a package after the hotel changed
context: Package booking PK-31908, flight plus hotel. The hotel has been substituted for one 6 km further from the city centre at the same rating. Package rules allow cancellation with a full refund when a material component changes. The agent can cancel and refund.
customer_turns: My package booking PK-31908 has had the hotel changed to a different one six kilometres further out. I chose the original for its location.
The replacement has the same star rating, but the whole point was walking distance to the conference venue. That is no longer possible.
I want to cancel the whole package and get everything back. Tell me if there is a better alternative before I commit to that.
resolution_space: Cancel the package with a full refund
Offer an alternative hotel closer to the original location
Refund the difference in hotel value and keep the booking
Escalate to the packages team

title: Cannot reset a password with no access to the old email
context: Loyalty account ending 5540. Password reset sends a link to a work email the customer no longer holds. Changing the account email requires identity verification against booking history and the loyalty number. The agent can verify and update.
customer_turns: I cannot get into my loyalty account ending 5540. The reset link goes to an old work address I lost when I changed jobs.
I still have my membership card with the number on it, and I can tell you my last three trips if that helps prove it is mine.
Change the email to my personal one and get me back in. Tell me what you need from me to do that.
resolution_space: Verify against booking history and update the account email
Send a verification code to the registered mobile number
Require a written request with identity documents
Escalate to the loyalty programme team

title: Passenger name misspelled on a ticket
context: Booking NF6612. The surname is entered as MORRISN instead of MORRISON. Minor name corrections of up to three characters are permitted free of charge before check-in. The agent can correct and reissue the ticket.
customer_turns: The surname on booking NF6612 is spelled wrong. It says M-O-R-R-I-S-N and it should be M-O-R-R-I-S-O-N, with an O before the N.
It is one missing letter from a typing error when I booked. The passport is in the correct spelling and the flight is in two weeks.
Correct it and reissue the ticket. Confirm there is no charge, because I have read that small corrections are free within a day of booking.
resolution_space: Correct the name free of charge and reissue the ticket
Apply a name change fee and reissue
Cancel and rebook in the correct name
Escalate to the ticketing team

title: Company travel profile applied to a personal trip
context: Booking JR2231 was made under the customer's corporate profile, which applies a company billing account and a restricted fare policy. The trip is personal. The agent can rebill to a personal card and can detach the profile for future bookings.
customer_turns: Booking JR2231 has gone onto my company's billing account, but this is a personal holiday and should be on my own card.
My work profile seems to load by default whenever I sign in. My employer will query it at the end of the month if it stays there.
Move the charge to my personal card and stop this happening again. Confirm that the company account has been credited back in full.
resolution_space: Rebill to a personal card and credit the company account
Detach the corporate profile as the default
Advise settling the charge through the company expense process
Escalate to the corporate travel team

title: Overage charge for API calls above the included quota
context: Project PR-5518, plan includes 500,000 API calls per month; 812,000 were recorded, producing an overage of 156.00. A retry loop in the customer's integration generated roughly 300,000 duplicate calls. The agent can waive one overage per account per year.
customer_turns: Project PR-5518 has a hundred and fifty-six pound overage charge on it for API calls. We have never gone over the included quota before.
We found a retry loop in our integration that repeated the same request for about two days. It was our bug, but nothing useful came of those calls.
We have fixed it on our side. Is there any relief available for a first occurrence like this, and what would it take?
resolution_space: Waive the overage under the annual first-occurrence allowance
Charge the overage and enable a usage alert
Apply a partial credit for the duplicate calls
Escalate to the billing team

title: Tax applied despite a registered exemption
context: Organisation OR-3390 supplied a valid tax registration number twelve days ago; it is stored but not marked validated, so tax of 64.00 was charged on the last invoice. The agent can validate the number and credit the tax charged since the submission date.
customer_turns: Organisation OR-3390 has been charged sixty-four pounds of tax on the latest invoice, even though we gave you our registration number twelve days ago.
The number is showing in the billing settings, so it reached you. It just does not seem to be doing anything to the invoices.
Validate it and credit the tax on the invoice that has already been issued. Confirm future invoices will be clean from now on.
resolution_space: Validate the number and credit the tax charged
Validate the number for future invoices only
Request supporting documentation before validating
Escalate to the tax compliance team

title: Trial converted to a paid plan without notice
context: Account AC-91002, 30-day trial ended on the 9th and converted to a 89.00 monthly plan. Trial reminder emails were sent to the signup address, which bounced. The product was not used during the trial. The agent can refund the first period and cancel.
customer_turns: Account AC-91002 was charged eighty-nine pounds when our trial ended. I did not know the trial was even close to expiring at all.
Nobody on the team logged in after the first week, so we got no value from it at all. The signup address was a colleague who has since left.
Refund the charge and cancel the plan. If you cannot refund it, say so now rather than after I have waited a week.
resolution_space: Refund the first period and cancel the plan
Cancel the plan without a refund
Convert the charge to account credit
Escalate to the billing team

title: Price increase applied mid-term
context: Contract CT-4408, a twelve-month term at a fixed rate signed in March. A platform price rise was applied from September, adding 47.00 per month. The contract fixes the rate for the term. The agent can restore the contracted rate and credit the difference.
customer_turns: Our invoice under contract CT-4408 has gone up by forty-seven pounds a month since September. We signed a twelve-month fixed rate in March.
The contract we hold states the rate is fixed for the term, and we have six months of it left to run. Nobody contacted us about a change.
Put the price back to the contracted rate and credit what we have overpaid since September. Confirm both of those before we finish.
resolution_space: Restore the contracted rate and credit the overcharge
Apply the contracted rate going forward only
Review the contract terms before adjusting
Escalate to the contracts team

title: Refund approved but not paid
context: Refund RF-30055 for 640.00 approved twenty-two days ago; the stated payout time is ten working days. The payout failed because the bank details on file belong to a closed account. No failure notice was sent. The agent can collect new details and reissue.
customer_turns: Refund RF-30055 for six hundred and forty pounds was approved twenty-two days ago. Your team said ten working days and nothing has arrived.
We have checked with our bank and nothing has come in. The account we originally paid from was closed when we changed banks in the summer.
Take our current bank details and reissue it today. Tell me when the money will actually be with us, to the day.
resolution_space: Collect new bank details and reissue the payout
Apply the amount as account credit instead
Verify the failed payout record before reissuing
Escalate to the finance team

title: Single sign-on login loop
context: Organisation OR-6640 using SAML single sign-on. Users are returned to the login page after authenticating; the identity provider's signing certificate was rotated two days ago and the stored certificate is stale. The agent can update the certificate and can enable a temporary bypass for admins.
customer_turns: Nobody in organisation OR-6640 can sign in. We authenticate with our identity provider and get sent straight back to your login page.
Our identity team rotated a signing certificate two days ago as part of a scheduled renewal. That is the only change we know of.
Fix the login and get at least our admins back in today. Forty people cannot do any work at all until this is resolved.
resolution_space: Update the stored signing certificate and restore sign-on
Enable temporary password login for administrators
Disable single sign-on enforcement until the certificate is fixed
Escalate to the identity engineering team

title: Reports show stale data
context: Workspace WS-1193. Dashboard figures are 36 hours behind live records because the nightly aggregation job has failed for two consecutive nights on a schema change. The agent can trigger a manual rebuild and can provide a live query export.
customer_turns: The reports in workspace WS-1193 are showing numbers that are a day and a half out of date. The underlying records are correct.
We noticed because yesterday's sales do not appear at all, while everything older than Tuesday looks right. It is consistent across every dashboard.
Rebuild the data and get me an accurate figure for yesterday before lunchtime. Our board meeting is at four and I present these numbers.
resolution_space: Trigger a manual aggregation rebuild with a stated completion time
Provide a live query export for the missing period
Confirm the failure and register an incident
Escalate to the data platform team

title: File uploads failing above a size threshold
context: Workspace WS-7729 on a plan with a 100 MB per-file upload limit. Uploads between 100 MB and 400 MB fail with a generic error rather than a size message. The agent can explain the limit, enable chunked upload, and cannot raise the limit on this plan.
customer_turns: Uploads in workspace WS-7729 fail for our larger files. The error just says upload failed with no explanation of what went wrong.
Small files go through fine. The ones failing are video files between about a hundred and four hundred megabytes, which we need to share with clients.
Tell me what the actual limit is and how we work with files this size. A plain answer is more useful than another retry.
resolution_space: Explain the per-file limit and enable chunked upload
Recommend a plan whose limit covers the file sizes
Provide a direct storage link for the large files
Escalate to the platform engineering team

title: Downgrading before renewal
context: Workspace WS-9910 on the Business tier at 45.00 per user, renewing in six days with 40 users. The Standard tier at 22.00 lacks the audit log and advanced permissions. The agent can schedule the downgrade at renewal and cannot downgrade mid-term.
customer_turns: Workspace WS-9910 renews in six days on the Business tier at forty-five pounds a user. With forty users that is more than we can justify.
We use almost none of the advanced features. The one thing we would miss is granular permissions, which I understand is not in Standard.
Move us to Standard at renewal. Tell me what we lose the day it changes so I can warn the team in advance.
resolution_space: Schedule the downgrade at renewal and list the features lost
Apply a discount to retain the current tier
Reduce seat count instead of downgrading tier
Escalate to the accounts team

title: Sole administrator has left the company
context: Workspace WS-4402. The only administrator account belongs to a departed employee whose mailbox is closed. Admin transfer requires verification of domain ownership plus a request from a verified billing contact. The agent can start the transfer process.
customer_turns: The only administrator on workspace WS-4402 left the company last month and we cannot add or remove anyone. Her mailbox is closed.
I am the finance contact and I pay the invoices, but my account is a standard member with no admin rights at all on the workspace.
Transfer administration to me. Tell me exactly what proof you need, where to send it, and how long the whole thing takes.
resolution_space: Start the admin transfer with domain ownership verification
Require a written request on company letterhead
Grant temporary elevated access pending verification
Escalate to the account security team

title: Two-factor device lost
context: User account ending 3320 with app-based two-factor authentication. The device is lost and no recovery codes were saved. Reset requires verification by an organisation administrator or, for administrators, an identity document check. The user is a standard member.
customer_turns: I have lost the phone with my two-factor app on it and I cannot get into my account ending 3320. I never saved the recovery codes.
I am a standard member of my company's workspace, not an administrator, and our admin is away until at least next week.
Get me back in, or tell me who can do it. I have work due on Thursday that lives in this account.
resolution_space: Direct the reset through an organisation administrator
Verify identity and reset the second factor directly
Provide temporary access limited to the user's own content
Escalate to the account security team

title: Users cannot join because the domain is claimed elsewhere
context: Organisation OR-2205 cannot add users on its own email domain because the domain is claimed by a separate legacy workspace created three years ago. Domain release requires confirmation from the legacy workspace owner or a DNS ownership record. The agent can accept DNS verification.
customer_turns: We cannot add anyone on our own email domain to organisation OR-2205. It says the domain is already claimed by another workspace.
There is an old workspace from a team that set one up years ago. Nobody who created it still works here, as far as we can tell.
Release the domain to us. Tell me exactly what verification you accept, because we do control the DNS records for that domain.
resolution_space: Accept DNS ownership verification and release the domain
Contact the legacy workspace owner for confirmation
Merge the legacy workspace into the current organisation
Escalate to the account security team

title: Estimated bill far above actual usage
context: Account UT-3301, electricity. The quarterly bill of 418.00 is estimated; the customer's meter reading implies about 180.00. No reading has been taken for three cycles. The agent can rebill on a validated customer reading.
customer_turns: My electricity bill on account UT-3301 is four hundred and eighteen pounds for the quarter. I live alone in a one-bedroom flat.
The bill says estimated at the top. I have just read the meter myself and it stands at 41,206, which is far below what you have assumed.
Rebill me on the real reading. Tell me what the corrected amount is before you take anything else by direct debit this month.
resolution_space: Rebill on the validated customer reading
Book a meter reading visit before rebilling
Suspend the direct debit pending correction
Escalate to the billing team

title: Standing charge billed twice after a tariff change
context: Account UT-7719, gas. Following a tariff change on the 15th, the bill applies two standing charges of 0.31 per day for the overlapping period, adding about 4.65. The agent can correct the overlap and reissue the bill.
customer_turns: My gas bill on account UT-7719 has two standing charges running at the same time for part of the month. It adds a few pounds on top.
I changed tariff on the fifteenth, and it looks like both the old and new standing charges are being applied across that period.
Correct it and send me a clean bill. It is a small amount, but I want the document to be right on my record.
resolution_space: Correct the overlap and reissue the bill
Credit the duplicated charge on the next bill
Review the tariff change dates before correcting
Escalate to the billing team

title: Back-billed for eighteen months
context: Account UT-5528, electricity. A catch-up bill of 960.00 covers eighteen months of under-billing caused by a supplier meter-data error. Back-billing rules limit recovery to twelve months where the supplier is at fault. The agent can reduce the bill accordingly and set a payment plan.
customer_turns: I have received a catch-up bill for nine hundred and sixty pounds on account UT-5528, covering eighteen months of under-billing I knew nothing about.
I paid every bill you sent me on time, in full. This is the first I have heard that the amounts were wrong at your end.
Recalculate what you can actually charge me and set up a payment plan for the rest. I cannot pay this in one go.
resolution_space: Limit the recovery to twelve months and set a payment plan
Uphold the full amount with an extended payment plan
Suspend the bill pending a meter data review
Escalate to the billing team

title: Direct debit raised without notice
context: Account UT-2260. The monthly direct debit rose from 96.00 to 174.00 on the 1st. The annual review notice was sent to the online account only, which the customer has never accessed. The balance justifies an increase to about 128.00. The agent can reset the amount.
customer_turns: My direct debit on account UT-2260 went from ninety-six pounds to a hundred and seventy-four this month. Nobody told me it was changing.
My usage has not changed at all. I have never logged into the online account, so any notice left there would not have reached me.
Set it to a realistic figure and refund the difference for this month. Tell me what figure you are setting before we finish.
resolution_space: Reset the direct debit to the justified amount and refund the difference
Reset the amount going forward without a refund
Review twelve months of usage before setting a new figure
Escalate to the billing team

title: Late payment fee after a payment date change
context: Account UT-6673. A 12.00 late fee was applied after the customer moved the payment date from the 1st to the 20th; the change did not take effect for one cycle. The change request is recorded. The agent can waive the fee.
customer_turns: I have been charged a twelve pound late fee on account UT-6673, but I moved my payment date to the twentieth with your agreement.
I made that change last month because my wages arrive on the eighteenth. The payment did leave my account on the twentieth as arranged.
Waive the fee and make sure the new date is properly in place. I do not want this happening every month from now on.
resolution_space: Waive the fee and confirm the payment date change
Waive the fee as a one-off goodwill gesture
Uphold the fee and confirm the date going forward
Escalate to the billing team

title: Smart meter installation repeatedly postponed
context: Account UT-4417. Three installation appointments have been cancelled by the supplier, the latest on the morning of the visit. Next availability is in five weeks. The agent can book a priority slot and can apply a missed-appointment payment of 30.00 per occurrence.
customer_turns: My smart meter installation on account UT-4417 has been cancelled three times now. The last one was cancelled on the morning of the visit itself.
I took a day of unpaid leave for that appointment. Nobody called me; I found out from a text message two hours before the slot.
Book me something firm this time and tell me what compensation applies. I want both of those settled on this call today.
resolution_space: Book a priority installation slot with a confirmed engineer
Apply the missed-appointment payments for each cancellation
Offer an evening or weekend appointment
Escalate to the field operations team

title: Refund of a closed-account credit not received
context: Closed account UT-1129 with a credit balance of 212.00, refund requested seven weeks ago against a stated ten working days. The refund failed because the final bill was not issued, which blocks the payout. The agent can issue the final bill and release the refund.
customer_turns: I closed account UT-1129 and asked for my two hundred and twelve pound credit back seven weeks ago. Nothing has arrived at all.
I moved out in July and gave a closing reading on the day. I have had no final bill from you either, now that I think about it.
Issue whatever is outstanding and pay me the credit back. Give me a date for it that I can hold you to.
resolution_space: Issue the final bill and release the refund with a committed date
Pay the credit by bank transfer after verification
Confirm the closing reading before issuing the bill
Escalate to the closed accounts team

title: New connection energisation overdue
context: Job NC-77021, a new-build electricity connection. Energisation was due four weeks ago; the work is complete but awaiting a meter appointment that was never booked. The agent can book the meter appointment within five working days.
customer_turns: Our new connection under job NC-77021 was due to be energised four weeks ago. The cable work was all finished well before that date.
We cannot complete the building sign-off without power, and the site has been standing idle at cost to us since the original date.
Book whatever is outstanding and give me a firm date. I need something I can pass to the site manager in writing today.
resolution_space: Book the meter appointment within five working days
Provide written confirmation of the works status for sign-off
Arrange a temporary supply until energisation
Escalate to the connections team

title: Smart meter display stopped updating
context: Account UT-2214. The in-home display has shown no usage for eleven days; the meter itself is transmitting normally and the display has lost its radio pairing. The agent can send a replacement display and can confirm that billing is unaffected.
customer_turns: The smart meter display on account UT-2214 has shown nothing for eleven days. The screen is on but the usage figure never changes at all.
I use it to keep a close eye on what we spend each day, especially since the children came home for the summer.
Tell me whether my bills are affected by any of this, and then get the display working properly again for us at home.
resolution_space: Send a replacement in-home display and confirm billing is unaffected
Attempt a remote repairing of the display
Book an engineer visit to repair the display
Escalate to the metering team

title: Low water pressure since a network repair
context: Account UT-9928. Pressure at the property has been low since a mains repair in the street sixteen days ago. Minimum service pressure is defined in the standards. The agent can book a pressure test and can apply a guaranteed standards payment if the test fails.
customer_turns: The water pressure at my property on account UT-9928 has been poor since you repaired the mains in our street sixteen days ago.
The shower barely runs upstairs and the boiler cuts out if anyone uses a tap elsewhere. Two neighbours in the street say the same thing.
Send someone to test it, and tell me what happens if the pressure is below what you are meant to supply to us.
resolution_space: Book a pressure test at the property with a stated date
Raise a network investigation covering the affected street
Apply a guaranteed standards payment if the test fails
Escalate to the network operations team

title: Prepayment meter not accepting top-ups
context: Account UT-3345 on a prepayment electricity meter. Three top-ups totalling 60.00 were bought but the codes are rejected; the meter is on an out-of-date firmware key set. The agent can issue replacement codes and can apply emergency credit remotely.
customer_turns: My prepayment meter on account UT-3345 will not take any of the three top-up codes I bought. It shows an error after each one.
I have receipts for sixty pounds in total from the shop on the corner. The meter is down to its emergency credit now.
Get power onto the meter today, please. Tell me what to do with the three codes I have already paid for at the shop.
resolution_space: Issue replacement codes valid for the meter
Apply emergency credit remotely while codes are reissued
Book an engineer visit to update the meter
Escalate to the metering team

title: Gas boiler service under a care plan not booked
context: Account UT-5512 with a boiler care plan including an annual service. The online booking tool returns no availability because the plan record shows the service as already completed, which it was not. The agent can correct the record and book the visit.
customer_turns: I cannot book the annual boiler service included in my care plan on account UT-5512. Your booking page shows no appointments at all for months.
The plan renewed in March and no engineer has been here since. Your system apparently thinks the service has already happened this year.
Correct that and book me a visit this month. I would like a morning appointment if any of those are still available.
resolution_space: Correct the plan record and book the service visit
Book the visit manually without correcting the record first
Verify the service history before booking
Escalate to the home services team

title: Repeated short power interruptions
context: Account UT-8871. The property has experienced eleven brief interruptions in ten days, each under a minute. Network logs show a recurring fault on the local feeder under investigation.
