The agent can register the address on the fault, can request an investigation visit, and cannot give a repair date.
customer_turns: The power at my property on account UT-8871 has cut out eleven times in ten days. Each one only lasts seconds, but it is constant.
It has already damaged a freezer full of food and my home office equipment keeps restarting. I work from home four days a week.
Tell me what is causing it and when it will stop. I also want to know how to claim for the damage.
resolution_space: Register the address on the existing feeder fault and provide the reference
Request an investigation visit at the property
Provide the claims process for the damaged equipment
Escalate to the network operations team

title: Cancelling a boiler care plan mid-term
context: Account UT-4490 on an annual boiler care plan of 288.00 paid monthly, four months in, with one repair visit already used at a list value of 190.00. Cancellation terms allow cancellation with the used-service value deducted. The agent can cancel and calculate the balance.
customer_turns: I want to cancel the boiler care plan on account UT-4490. I am moving to a flat with a communal heating system in six weeks.
I have had one repair visit under the plan, back in June, when the pressure kept dropping. Otherwise I have not used it.
Tell me what cancelling costs me given that visit. I will decide whether to cancel now or run it to the move.
resolution_space: Cancel and deduct the used-service value from the balance
Cancel at the move date with no deduction
Transfer the plan to the new property where eligible
Escalate to the home services team

title: Landlord and tenant both billed for one supply
context: Property supply UT-2291 has two open accounts, one in the landlord's name and one in the tenant's, for overlapping periods. The tenancy agreement determines liability from 1 March. The agent can close the landlord account from that date.
customer_turns: Both my landlord and I are receiving bills for the same supply at UT-2291. He has forwarded me his and they overlap with mine.
My tenancy started on the first of March and I opened my account that week. His account appears to have stayed open throughout.
Sort out which account is live from March and close the other one. Neither of us wants to pay twice for the same supply.
resolution_space: Close the landlord account from the tenancy start date
Request the tenancy agreement before adjusting either account
Rebill both accounts against the correct liability dates
Escalate to the account services team

title: Meter serial on the bill does not match the property
context: Account UT-4433. The meter serial on the bill belongs to a neighbouring property; usage patterns suggest the two supplies were crossed at registration. The agent can raise a supply verification and cannot rebill until it completes.
customer_turns: The meter serial number printed on my bill for account UT-4433 does not match the meter in my cupboard. The numbers are completely different.
My neighbour mentioned her bills look unusually low, and mine have looked far too high since we both moved in two years ago.
Check whether our supplies have been crossed. Tell me what happens to the bills either of us has already paid over those years.
resolution_space: Raise a supply verification visit for both properties
Suspend billing pending the verification outcome
Correct the meter serial on the account record
Escalate to the metering team

title: Tariff change blocked by an outstanding balance
context: Account UT-7051 carries an arrears balance of 280.00, which blocks a tariff change under the credit rules. A payment plan clearing the arrears within twelve months restores eligibility. The agent can set up the plan and apply the tariff on its first payment.
customer_turns: I am trying to move to your cheaper fixed tariff on account UT-7051 and the website will not let me. It gives no reason at all.
I do owe about two hundred and eighty pounds from the winter, which I have been paying off a bit at a time when I can.
Tell me whether the balance is the reason and what I must do to qualify. I want the cheaper rate as soon as possible.
resolution_space: Set up a payment plan and apply the tariff at its first payment
Apply the tariff immediately with the arrears carried over
Explain the credit rule and decline the change for now
Escalate to the customer support team
